## Trends (as of 2026-10-17)
- Zelda 40th Anniversary Switch 2: Nintendo's first special-edition Switch 2. Triforce dock, green and gold Joy-Con, $519.99. Under two weeks to go, and finding stock is still the real boss fight. Source: https://www.nintendo.co.jp/corporate/release/en/2026/260908_2.html
- Ocarina of Time remake: The N64 legend, rebuilt for Switch 2. Real jump button, free camera, and yes, you can hum into the mic. Source: https://www.gematsu.com/2026/09/the-legend-of-zelda-ocarina-of-time-remake-launches-november-5
- GTA VI: Under five weeks out. Preload opens Nov 12. The internet is already counting the minutes. Source: https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/
- Star Wars: Galactic Racer is a hit: Ten days after launch, reviewers are calling it one of the best racing games in years, and Steam players are still lining up for podracer and speeder chaos. Source: https://www.polygon.com/star-wars-galactic-racer-review-roundup/
- Deadlock keeps breaking Steam records: Valve's hero shooter and MOBA mashup is still invite-only, and it just hit about 303,000 players at once on Steam. That's past Team Fortress 2's all-time peak, which it first beat on Oct 9. A new hero vote keeps pulling people back. Source: https://steamdb.info/app/1422450/charts/
- VisionQuest on Disney+: Paul Bettany is back as Vision and James Spader's Ultron is in his head. Episodes 1 and 2 dropped Oct 13, with new ones on Tuesdays. Source: https://www.disneyplus.com/explore/articles/marvel-visionquest
- Girls is coming back to HBO: Lena Dunham is reviving Girls for five episodes, and Allison Williams, Jemima Kirke, Zosia Mamet and Andrew Rannells are all back. Production starts in 2027, a decade after the finale. Source: https://apnews.com/article/girls-reboot-lena-dunham-d5261c3af7194f15d619607052f8f7e8
- Helluva Boss S3 (and Stolas): Prime Video weekly drops; Stolas is trending hard on X. Part 1 finale lands Oct 28. Source: https://www.radiotimes.com/tv/fantasy/helluva-boss-season-3-release-schedule/
- You Can See Everything is a box office story: Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim's Elizabeth Holmes documentary made $5.3M on Friday (with previews) in just 885 theaters. Deadline expects about $12M for the weekend, which would beat Melania's $7.1M, the best documentary opening in ten years. Source: https://deadline.com/2026/10/box-office-street-fighter-you-can-see-everything-1237159320/
- Street Fighter wins Friday: Paramount's live-action Street Fighter made $12.5M on Friday, previews included, and is heading for about $30M, the low end of expectations. Fun fact from Deadline: that's close to the 1994 movie's entire run ($33.4M). Source: https://deadline.com/2026/10/box-office-street-fighter-you-can-see-everything-1237159320/
- Narnia: The Magician's Nephew trailer: Greta Gerwig's Narnia, scored to Stairway to Heaven, with Meryl Streep voicing Aslan. Big swing. Our take: it works. Source: https://variety.com/2026/film/news/narnia-the-magicians-nephew-trailer-greta-gerwig-netflix-1236909994/
- Other Mommy slides to third: Last weekend's winner is down about 73% in weekend two, per Deadline's projection, for roughly $7.4M and $43.9M total. New openers Whalefall and Sense & Sensibility are both tracking around $6M to $7M. Source: https://deadline.com/2026/10/box-office-street-fighter-you-can-see-everything-1237159320/
- The Pinterest vibe check: Search singer, vinyl, season and character on Pinterest, screenshot the first image for each, and post the grid. It's your algorithm's read on you, in four squares, and it's weirdly accurate. Source: https://x.com/i/trending/2110082409811087529
- Show us your lock screen: Today's X game: post your phone's lock screen and let strangers guess your whole personality. Anime, deities, space shots, couple photos, chaotic memes. It's the most low-effort, high-reveal trend of the week. Source: https://x.com/i/trending/2111046779110318263
- Olivia Rodrigo x Chappell Roan "expectations": Olivia's first-ever remix and Chappell's first-ever feature, out now. The video is a retro game show hosted by David Byrne. Yes, really. Source: https://www.universalmusic.ca/2026/10/15/olivia-rodrigo-releases-expectations-remix-featuring-chappell-roan/
- Tate McRae's "Housewife": Her first new music since So Close To What: a synth-pop independence anthem with a video shot in the South of France. Fans are chanting the money line everywhere, and she performs at the Victoria's Secret show Sunday. Source: https://www.sonymusic.ca/press_release/tate-mcrae-releases-housewife
- Harry Styles sings for Liam Payne: On the second anniversary of Liam Payne's death, Harry debuted an unreleased song he wrote for his friend, "What Is Enough," at Madison Square Garden. "It's just about looking after each other," he told the crowd. Source: https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/harry-styles-liam-payne-new-song-msg-1235644335/
- Taylor Swift's "Patient Zero": Second straight week at No. 1 on the Hot 100. Her 16th chart-topper. TikTok is using it for wedding edits. Source: https://www.billboard.com/lists/taylor-swift-patient-zero-hot-100-number-one-second-week/

- Shutdown watch: the real deadline is Dec 11: Correction: there is no Oct 31 funding cliff. The stopgap law signed Sept 2 (H.R. 6500) funds the government through Dec 11, 2026. Congress is out until after the election, and leaders in both parties will face that deadline in the lame-duck session. Source: https://www.presidency.ucsb.edu/documents/congressional-bill-hr-6500-signed-into-law
